changed_behaviour: Batch check results' error field now carries the limitation text for unknown-membership results when strict mode is on.
rationale: Contract says error is any error generated while checking; strict-mode limitation text not mentioned.

changed_behaviour: Variant annotation gains a new genomicLocationExplanation string property in the response model.
rationale: Only a bean field added; endpoint not identifiable; no contract.

changed_behaviour: Submodel element create/update/delete/set-value in the in-memory service are now synchronized; createSubmodelElement no longer calls setSubmodelElements.
rationale: Concurrency locking only; no HTTP-visible change evident; no contract.

changed_behaviour: New subGroupsCount query parameter (default true) controls subgroup counts; brief representation no longer suppresses counts for subgroups.
rationale: No contract file in repository at parent commit.

changed_behaviour: Connection create/modify validation now rejects invalid response-diversion header mappings; new divert-* header definitions added.
rationale: Only helm/k8s swagger-ui deployment files, no API description; validator body not fully inspected.

changed_behaviour: Canonical URL in question page metadata now uses short question id form for the short-ID permalink setting too.
rationale: Server-rendered page route; swagger covers only /answer/api paths.

changed_behaviour: Gitspace create accepts new code_repo_ref field, used to look up internal repo instead of code_repo_url; action errors if ref missing.
rationale: Contract lists code_repo_id, code_repo_type, code_repo_url only; no code_repo_ref.

changed_behaviour: Request with unknown HTTP method now marks the request handled after sending 405.
rationale: Handler-level fix for any unsupported method; no contract.

changed_behaviour: Artifacts and versions created through the APIs now record the authenticated principal as owner.
rationale: Owner property exists in schema but contract does not say it is set from caller identity.

changed_behaviour: Session credential refresh now throttles failed silent token renewals for 60s and treats an expired, unrenewable token as invalid.
rationale: Session-level auth behaviour on any authenticated request; no specific operation.

changed_behaviour: Kafka operations now run on a bounded executor; when saturated, requests get 503 'Bridge is overloaded, please retry later'.
rationale: Contract has no 503 overload response for these operations.

changed_behaviour: Attachment upload now requires non-null file and fileName form parts, otherwise request fails.
rationale: Operation inferred from mapper name; no contract.

changed_behaviour: Validation error messages are now capitalised and end with a period.
rationale: Applies to many endpoints using shared validator; no per-operation text in contract.

changed_behaviour: Cancelling a reusable-workflow caller run reports caller jobs by reloading status after children cascade rather than cancelling them directly.
rationale: Contract describes cancel generally; nothing on nested caller handling.

changed_behaviour: Compatibility config: GET falls back to default global rule instead of NONE; setting NONE now stores a rule instead of deleting it.
rationale: Contract lacks fallback default and NONE-handling semantics.
